results.title: OCHA Reaffirms Commitment to Supporting Afghanistan
results.description: The United Nations humanitarian office in Afghanistan has called for continued international support as growing humanitarian needs and a severe funding shortfall threaten the delivery of lifesaving assistance to vulnerable Afghans. results.title: Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan Meets Wife Bushra Bibi, Sister After 9 Months In Adiala Jail
results.description: Imran Khan met wife Bushra Bibi and sister after nine months inside Adiala Jail following a Supreme Court order allowing family meetings amid health concerns and ongoing legal battles in Pakistan.
